tests.title: When ScanInput.Lang is set, Scan classifies Go files by profile and other source files via Detection.IsSourceFile
given: a temp repo with one .go file and one .py file
a ScanInput with Lang set to a Detection that has go and python profiles
tests.when: Scan is called with both files in Changed
then: the .go file is processed by scanGoFile (produces go/ast-backed findings)
the .py file is processed by scanSourceFile (produces regex-backed findings)
no call to project.IsSourceFile is made for classification
tests.pseudocode:
det := lang.Detection{All: []lang.Profile{goProfile, pythonProfile}}
out := Scan(ctx, ScanInput{Root: root, Changed: []string{"main.go", "app.py"}, Added: added, Lang: det})
assert all findings for main.go have Backend=="go/ast"
assert all findings for app.py have Backend=="regex"

tests.pseudocode:
det := detection where IsSourceFile(".py")=true, TestFile("app.py")=false
out := Scan(ctx, ScanInput{Root: root, Changed: []string{"app.py"}, Added: added, Lang: det})
assert any(f.Check == CheckDiscardedError for f in out)
